decisions.reason: The stated boundary disk lacked D∩S=α and D∩∂E=β. Noncompact half-open collar annuli also passed the old surface convention, and disconnected witnesses made strictness depend on irrelevant extra components. Restored compact surfaces, connected realizing witnesses, and exact disk intersections; these are the standard essential-surface conventions.

The cited simplicial theorem expressly supplies only homotopies of pairs. Repaired the missing boundary-relative step by ambient-simplex vertex interpolation fixed on a PL collar, barycentric neighborhood retraction, and facewise PL interpolation. These homotopies fix the boundary, preserve π1 and degree, and license the existing surface classifier and relative isotopy theorem.

The exact authored word is C=X4 A⁻¹ B X3⁻¹. At M=t=1 direct multiplication gives C=[[2,-5],[-1,3]], with trace 5, agreeing with the displayed right side. Exact Laurent expansion gives identically zero residual before imposing F=0. The claimed counterexample uses an incorrect multiplication; the relator, dense curve realization, irreducibility and final longitude trace remain valid.

F3 explicitly invokes the supplier construction. Its Proof1.1 chooses a semisimple word and a word outside the two proper eigenline stabilizer subgroups; a group is not the union of two proper subgroups. Proof2.1 normalizes the nonzero product q. The consuming trace formula for q and nonvanishing specialization certificate are therefore licensed by an actually proved intermediate result, not an unsupported assertion.

The cited rational-locus supplier Proof1.1–2.1 explicitly proves σ(E_K)=E_K by applying each field automorphism to presentation matrices and the nonzero eigenvector, then its inverse. In addition the consuming Proof1.1 supplies integer chart equations, which imply the same stability directly. F3 then licenses component selection and rational descent; no closure-to-raw inference is needed.

The actual dependency def-adjoint-twisted-homology-and-culler-shalen-data explicitly defines admissible by the ordered peripheral basis AND dim ker i_*=1. The slope definition links that definition, and the lemma declares it in deps. Thus Proof3.1 correctly obtains r−β=1 from the stipulated dense admissible locus. Gaussian rank localization, norm-based shrinking and the explicit quadratic conjugation then give the claimed rational projective descent.

The valued-model supplier explicitly constructs the toric chart in Proof2.1, its boundary-branch DVR in Proof3.1 and a generic-incidence closed point with finite residue-field extension in Proof2.2. Those disputed operations are valid. The phrase finite-field incorrectly suggests a finite field instead of a finite extension of C(Y); replaced that phrase only. The primitive-normal orthogonality and essential-surface application remain unchanged.

The cited generic-conormal supplier has exactly the referenced Proof8.1: reducible characters form the abelian trace line, L=1, and the fixed diagonal coefficient summand has longitude zero and meridian nonzero in exterior homology. This proves slope zero and the conormal identity. Its Proof2.2–7.1 proves the irreducible generic case; the valued differential and stipulated-surface calculation then gives −r. The rejection overlooks an explicit proved dependency clause.

The rejected F5 citation is valid: it explicitly invokes the full supplier proof, whose Proof1.1–3.1 constructs the matrices, exact F relator and converse irreducible representations. Thus the infinite-M family and Laurent ideal argument are sound. A separate confirmed diagram defect put each negative understrand endpoint on the overstrand, making two contacts. Corrected both gaps to lie on their descending understrand and corrected the source coauthor name to Vincent Florens; formulas and verification are unchanged.

Proof1.1 explicitly repeats the field-linear calculation rather than applying the curve-only conclusion. Trace self-duality and pair exactness give dim ker i_*=rank i_*=1 over any finitely generated characteristic-zero coefficient field once the torus pair is nonparabolic. The supplier Proof3.1–4.1 pairs every derivation with word cycles without a dimension-one assumption. If M,L were independent, their coordinate derivations would give two independent pairs annihilating that same line, a contradiction. No circular use of the curve conclusion occurs.

Proof5.1 repeats the rank/derivation argument over the actual generic incidence field; it does not apply the narrower curve conclusion. The trace form, duality and pair exactness force one peripheral kernel line, while algebraically independent M,L would have independent coordinate derivations annihilating it. Reducible images have L=1. Finite component decomposition then puts the nonconstant arc on the A-curve, and the displayed Vandermonde argument proves rationality. The external instanton interfaces remain explicitly imported.

The cited input module explicitly states full-set boundedness in external L2 and proves it in Proof3.1: every reduced p/q satisfies |p/q−r0|<C/q, and distinct slopes have denominators tending to infinity. Thus every infinite transferred subset converges to the same finite limit. The consumer L1 accurately cites those clauses, and its compactness argument is sound. The signed torus direction has the exact primitive relation μh^n=1, while the full converse is honestly imported independently in F6.

F1 names the classification supplier Proof2.1, which explicitly derives reflection (M,L)↦(M⁻¹,L) from the positive-meridian normal orientation and the degree-one null-homologous longitude, and orientation reversal inverts both. Those changes preserve irreducibility and image dimensions, so the signed Newton slope is pq. Equality with the positive target gives pq=ab>0; Alexander breadth gives the absolute parameter sum, and the quadratic recovers the unordered pair. The unit-parameter case is handled separately.

F2 invokes the actual construction, not component extraction from an unspecified disconnected surface. The enhanced-edge supplier Proof2.1 produces a connected essential nonfiber surface through its explicit lattice-tree supplier, whose Statement and Proof8.1–10.1 supply exactly that component. Thus a zero enhanced edge has a connected nonfiber witness; the repaired longitudinal lemma forces it to separate. Polygon nonthinness supplies two distinct strict slopes and the ordinary L−1 factor supplies zero. The corrected compact connected boundary-slope definition agrees with these witnesses.
